As of 2026, she is 44 years old, and her birth date places her under the Capricorn sign.

sections.heading: Catherine, Princess of Wales — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Catherine, Princess of Wales was born on 9 January 1982 in Royal Berkshire Hospital, and holds British nationality. She was given the name Catherine Elizabeth Middleton at birth and is publicly known as Catherine, Princess of Wales.
Public records name her father, Michael Middleton and her mother, Carole Middleton. She is a sibling of Pippa Middleton and James Middleton.
Her listed education includes St Andrew's School, Pangbourne, Downe House, Marlborough College and University of St Andrews.
She is recorded as speaking English.

sections.heading: Catherine, Princess of Wales — Career and Professional Work
paras: Her professional record lists businessperson, socialite, philanthropist and aristocrat as her occupations.
